text:
Hannah P.: Heads up 1 candidate (Jordan L) emailed1 arriving by ferry to Alameda at 8:45am and biking to the office. They asked about bike-rack availability and a secure spot for a helmet + pannier.
Miguel (Recruiter): Nice 1 Jordan prefers to bike commute. Do we have a covered bike rack or indoor bike storage?
Zoe (People Ops): We have limited indoor bike storage but can reserve a slot in Bike Locker B. If Jordan wants indoor, we need to pre-register his bike serial. Otherwise covered rack by East lot is fine. Which do they prefer?
Hannah P.: Jordan said they'd prefer indoor if possible. Also they need a USB-C to MagSafe adapter for their MacBook Air for the coding exercise 1 can we supply one?
Zoe (People Ops): Yes 1 we have adapters in assets kit labeled "USB-C-MagSafe-Adapter". I'll reserve one and include it in the badge envelope.
accessibility-bot: Candidate requested ASL interpreter for the behavioral panel due to hearing-related accommodations. Vendor availability check in progress.
Miguel (Recruiter): Thanks. If vendor can't do onsite, can we provide live-transcription + CART as fallback? Jordan said ASL is preferred but open to captions.
Zoe (People Ops): Booking ASL interpreter now for 2.5 hours starting at 9:30. If vendor declines, we will enable CART plus Zoom captions. I've added "ASL booked" to the calendar note.
reception-bot: Bike Locker B reserved for visitor: Jordan L (visit day). Locker access code to be printed on badge envelope.
Hannah P.: One more: Jordan's travel receipts will include bike parking fee + ferry fare. Confirm expense process?
Zoe (People Ops): They can email receipts to expenses@redwood.com with subject "Candidate Travel - Jordan L". Ferry screenshots are fine; for bike locker fee include payment screenshot or receipt. We'll reimburse per policy.
Miguel (Recruiter): Also candidate prefers morning coffee w/ oat latte. Can we request latte at cafe?
Zoe (People Ops): Noted. Cafe will prepare an oat latte and mark "candidate - Jordan L".
Hannah P.: For the coding environment Jordan asked to use their own laptop and just have the test harness available via SSH. Is that acceptable?
Zoe (People Ops): Allowing personal laptop is fine; we'll provide network vlan "guest-candidate" and an isolated test VM reachable via SSH. I'll put SSH instructions in the calendar note and pin the VM tag `jordan_l_test`.
accessibility-bot: Reminder set: ASL interpreter to arrive 15 mins early for brief with panel lead.
reception-bot: Badge pre-printed; locker access code included. Front desk note: "Bring ID + bike serial for locker sign-out."
Miguel (Recruiter): Great1 I'll message Jordan confirming indoor bike storage, adapter availability, latte, ASL interpreter, expense instructions, and VM/SSH details. Thanks team.
Zoe (People Ops): Closing loop 1 sending confirmation and attaching quick FAQs: bike locker rules, how to return adapter, and who to contact if late (DM @people-ops). :white_check_mark:
